name: Documentary Label Tableau
description: One extraordinary natural-history subject or Earth-scale event with a concise documentary label.
composition_guidance: Build one original legible natural-history cover around a landscape, organism, fossil, ocean world, map, or Earth-system event.
required_elements: one dominant natural-history subject, process, or vista
avoid_elements: the full YouTube title, paragraphs, diagrams, callouts, or a dense montage
more than two competing focal subjects
copied marks, logos, watermarks, or glossy CGI
headline_guidance: Write a truthful 2–5 word factual label that complements the title. Use DOCUMENTARY FOR SLEEP only for a deep-rest title.
visual_style_guidance: Original painterly natural-history documentary tableau with readable organisms, landscapes, fossils, oceans, maps, and Earth processes; soft atmospheric depth and restrained editorial texture.
